blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Filipino bound for Russia for an alleged security-related job offer was intercepted at the Mactan-Cebu International Airport, the Bureau of Immigration (BI) said on Sunday. According to the BI, a 50-year-old Filipino was intercepted at the airport as he attempted to depart via Cathay Pacific flight to Vietnam last Oct. 10. Upon initial questioning, the passenger said that he was bound for Russia as his work destination for a K9 handler position.
